blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the key warning signs that your Lara home's switchboard requires an upgrade for safety and modern electrical demands.
body: An outdated switchboard is a hidden hazard in many Lara homes, potentially leading to electrical fires or failures. Key signs include frequent circuit breaker trips, which indicate the system is overloaded by modern appliances. In Lara, where homes may have air conditioners, ovens, and multiple devices, an old switchboard without safety switches can't handle the load. Precision Wiring recommends an upgrade if your switchboard is over 20 years old or lacks residual current devices (RCDs), now mandatory under Australian standards.
